_purpose: Per-customer OpEx allocation rules (Rule N1, admin-editable). Used by utils.customer_pbt_allocator.compute_pbt_by_customer to distribute bank.total_opex_kes_b across individual customers. Per-customer is the atomic profitability unit; all other rollups (Bank, SBU, Branch, Staff) derive from this.

_available_rules.revenue_weighted: Customer's OpEx share = their revenue (interest + fee income) share of total. Standard activity-based costing. Default — aligns OpEx attribution with value generated.
_available_rules.balance_weighted: Customer's OpEx share = their balance footprint (deposits + loan_outstanding) share of total. Reflects capital tied up / oversight need.
_available_rules.equal: Split evenly across customers with any activity. Useful for sanity-check / diagnostic only — doesn't reflect real cost drivers.
_available_rules.hybrid: 50% revenue + 50% balance, weights configurable above. Compromise between value-based and footprint-based attribution.

_design_notes.atomic_unit: Per-customer is the foundational profitability unit. Σ(customer PBT) = Bank PBT (G256). Σ(customer PBT for customers in SBU/branch/staff portfolio) = SBU/Branch/Staff PBT respectively.
_design_notes.drift_absorption: OpEx allocation drift (from Decimal share-fraction rounding) is absorbed by the largest-revenue customer, ensuring Σ(customer OpEx) = bank.total_opex EXACTLY.
_design_notes.staff_aggregation: Per-staff PBT (compute_pbt_by_staff) is Σ over customers tagged to that staff via customers.csv::rm_code. The function returns ALL tagged staff without filtering by role — portfolio owners (BRM/SRO/RO) and service staff (Tellers/CSOs) appear together. Role-based filtering is a UI concern handled by joining staff_code → role from users.json or hr.json.
_design_notes.future_evolution: When per-transaction staff tags are available in CBS (currently only one rm_code per account), service-cost attribution can separate from portfolio attribution via cost_allocation_rules.json::matrix mode.
